metadata.collection_method: Authorized assistant UI reading; not user in-person observation or a field survey
metadata.sampling: Ten unique messages from one bounded visible Rev’s Casino sample, read on two occasions. Repeated sightings do not add messages. No full channel history, complete time interval or other challenge content was acquired.
metadata.provenance: Message IDs, visible dates/times, display-label aliases and paraphrases supplied by the main assistant after reading the Discord interface. Original usernames and verbatim message text are omitted.
metadata.identity_note: A–E distinguish five visible display labels within this sample. They are not verified accounts, unique people or teams.
metadata.eligibility_note: The written Build-A-Dataset guide requires primary physical-world collection. The user reports an organizer exception allowing remote observations; its exact scope has not been independently verified.
limits: Seven challenge channels have not been read; missing metrics are null, not zero
No messages-per-hour calculation: the sample does not cover a complete interval
No total participant, team, entrant or valid-submission counts
No inferred mental health, difficulty ratings, prize motivation or personal winning probability
Categories are single-assistant interpretations, not validated survey responses
metadata.reaction_note: Latest observed reaction counts cover only two of ten sampled messages. Counts across emoji are reaction events, not unique reactors. Exact capture times are unavailable, so no reaction growth or velocity is estimated.
metadata.navigation_attempt_note: Attempts to navigate to other challenge message contents were blocked by the UI tool. Sidebar channel links are known, but the seven other channels remain unread.

definitions.social_banter: Brief social or conversational content without a specific request, progress claim or concrete strategy signal in this coding.
definitions.strategy_discussion: A statement about an approach to trying the challenge; effectiveness is not verified.
definitions.progress_report: A self-reported challenge goal or current progress; completion and team membership are not verified.
definitions.collaboration: An invitation to collaborate; it does not establish actual team membership.
definitions.unclassified_media: A visible image message whose content is not classified; no image-content inference is made.
definitions.leaderboard_request: An explicit request for a leaderboard or leaderboard update.

coding_scheme.interpretation: Categories describe sampled message content, not verified participation, team strength, feelings or outcomes.
